metadata.title: Arcana Runtime Characteristics
metadata.status: Provisional code-grounded analysis; no game code changed.

measurement_rules.largest_single_footprint: Largest single collision footprint or simultaneous formation at one phase. Estimates omit enemy collision radius.
measurement_rules.estimated_unique_cast_coverage: Approximate union of floor space touched over a cast where deterministic geometry permits it.
measurement_rules.threat_envelope: Used instead of floor area for autonomous agents, homing ammunition, and mobile formations.
measurement_rules.size_scaling: Most collision areas scale approximately with Arcana Size squared. Four standalone-source cards have an additional baked 2x source scale at size 1.

contact_reliability.5: Radial, autonomous, homing, or otherwise highly reliable

full_value_reliability.2: Defining payoff needs a demanding condition
full_value_reliability.3: Commonly gets partial value; ceiling requires retention/alignment
full_value_reliability.4: Usually realizes most of its intended sequence
full_value_reliability.5: A successful contact normally guarantees the whole payload

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Expanding frontal plume
arcana.Origin / ownership: Each beat snapshots the caster frame; plume is caster-connected at emission
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Charged plume estimate; reach includes 1.05 origin offset. Uncharged finisher is much smaller.
arcana.Defense: Charged source mutations are not enabled
arcana.Resource / commitment: Three-beat string; hold final beat up to 1.05 s
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Hold through Beat 3 for charged 28-damage plume

arcana.Compound tags: piercing; crossing sweet spot; long lane
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Four diagonal flame-wave capsules with crossing final pair
arcana.Origin / ownership: Independent projectiles launched from offset sides
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Whole-cast union of the four current wave paths; final pair can overlap one target.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Target must occupy the final crossing region to take both finisher waves

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Straight circular projectile capsule with two authored hops
arcana.Origin / ownership: Three independent projectiles
arcana.Aim model: Activation snapshot for each emitted shot
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Unique lane coverage is approximately one capsule because all three shots reuse the same lane; density is ×3.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No special condition; shots end on first enemy

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Growing frontal annular sectors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Brief caster-anchored arcs at emission
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest third slash; max reach includes .44 forward origin offset.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No special condition; full string requires target to remain in successive arcs

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Seven stored orbit slots that become homing projectile corridors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Formation follows caster; each flare independently acquires
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Use threat envelope rather than one area: 1.65 storage orbit + 16-unit acquisition range; seven independent lanes.
arcana.Defense: Each flare can trade with an eligible hostile projectile
arcana.Resource / commitment: Exactly 7 stored flares; 4 s storage lifetime
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Each flare needs an eligible target inside acquisition range before storage expires
arcana.Produces states: projectile intercepted; pushed; repeated autonomous hits

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Alternating sinusoidal piercing corridors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Stock is emitted as independently owned dragons
arcana.Aim model: Live aim sampled on every emission
arcana.Multiplicity / density: Up to 8 stock; alternating two wave phases
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Approximate union of the two mirrored sinusoidal paths; repeated stock increases density rather than unique geometry.
arcana.Resource / commitment: Stores 8; regenerates one every .6 s; spends all available stock
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value scales with stored stock and target remaining in the steered stream

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Fixed circular disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned at the cast position
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Entire disk is checked; the visual vortex is not a hollow ring for gameplay.
arcana.Control: Low inward force, then strong outward clear
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must remain inside for all four ticks and finisher

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Straight projectile capsule → attached single-target prison
arcana.Origin / ownership: Projectile becomes target-owned after first contact
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 2 ammo charges; one target per projectile
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Swept projectile corridor; attached prison is single-target rather than floor area.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Once first contact occurs, impact and five timed ticks are highly reliable

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two moving orbit discs → full radial finisher disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: Orbit follows live caster; finisher centered on current caster
arcana.Aim model: First disc starts in activation aim; finisher radial
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest footprint is the final full disk. Orbit discs sweep an annular route around the moving caster.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value requires orbiting discs to recontact before the radial finisher

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Repeated very narrow piercing capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: Nine independent micro-projectiles
arcana.Coverage interpretation: All nine jets largely reuse one narrow lane; high density, low unique area.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full damage requires a target to remain aligned through nine independently owned jets

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Wide forward strips with short caster advance
arcana.Origin / ownership: Temporary fist remains caster-connected
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest second-punch strip; max reach includes .56 collision-clipped caster advance.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full string requires keeping the target in front after the first knockback

arcana.Compound tags: swept whip; bundled thrust; shared ledger
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two 3-unit swept whip sectors → three-strand 5.6-unit bundle
arcana.Origin / ownership: Copied curated source; connected to cast frame
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 2 whips + 3 visible finisher strands / 1 shared hit
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Whips sweep about ±0.79 rad; finisher tests three narrow strips at ±.2 rad. Exact union is intentionally left unranked.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No special trigger; finisher's three strands share one logical hit
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Live curated geometry is 3.0 / 5.6 reach, not the unused generic 5.25 / 7.0 specification.

arcana.Compound tags: long range; projectile string; heavy finisher
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two small projectile capsules → larger boulder capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: Three independent straight projectiles
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest boulder corridor; first two stones are narrower but mostly reuse it.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No special condition

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Four short rectangles; final beat also emits a broad annular sector
arcana.Origin / ownership: Copied curated source at cast frame
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Final 151° sector dominates the compact 1.75 × 1.56 contact rectangles.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Final broad arc is emitted regardless, but earlier compact hits require close attachment
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: The selected curated port animates source-local lunge but does not move the live player, despite movement language in the card.

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Instant narrow strip; conditional target-centered burst
arcana.Origin / ownership: Caster-to-forward stream ignores world collision
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Base strip is 3.70 sq units; fifth-contact burst is 6.61 around the struck target, so whole-cast union depends on target position.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Beat 5 must contact an enemy or no finisher burst appears

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Short projectile capsule + range-expiry disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: One disc per manual press
arcana.Aim model: Live aim independently on each press
arcana.Coverage interpretation: One disc lane plus its 1.38-radius miss burst. Three presses may redirect, so total union can be larger.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Miss at maximum range hands damage to the burst; wall contact fizzles; direct hit has no damaging burst

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Four very narrow forward strips with collision-clipped advance
arcana.Origin / ownership: Blade remains connected to caster
arcana.Aim model: Live aim and movement intent sampled every beat
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest fourth thrust; max reach adds .84 caster advance.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No shard or freeze in current base form; full value requires continued close tracking

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Three broad piercing projectile capsules
arcana.Origin / ownership: Independent crescents from a committed activation
arcana.Aim model: Aim snapshot; aim and movement locked during emission
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Three waves mostly reuse the same 10.38-square-unit corridor.
arcana.Defense: Pierces and destroys eligible hostile projectiles without being consumed
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value requires remaining aligned while the player cannot move or re-aim

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Three-beat narrow stream lanes with a doubled final beat
arcana.Origin / ownership: Four independently owned piercing streams
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Union of center line and the final ±.28 lateral pair.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value requires aligning all four carriers

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Proximal disk compresses into a piercing projectile capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: Three repeated, independently hittable phases
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Approximate union of the 1.25-radius rift at 1.28 forward and its 10.8-unit core lane; repeated cycles add density.
arcana.Defense: Both phases destroy eligible hostile projectiles
arcana.Coded full-value condition: A close target can legitimately receive both proximal and projectile phases

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Persistent dash-route capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: Flame strip is world-owned along the collision-clipped dash path
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Route-length estimate uses the standard 8.4-unit dash before wall clipping.
arcana.Resource / commitment: 5.5 s payload cooldown; dash movement still works while payload cools
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must intersect or remain on the brief flame strip for multiple ticks

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Dash followed by three close parallel projectile capsules
arcana.Origin / ownership: Projectiles spawn behind and catch the caster
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Projectile-only union after the dash; engagement reach combines 8.4 dash plus 13 projectile range. Lanes overlap slightly.
arcana.Resource / commitment: 5.5 s payload cooldown; movement remains available
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value requires targets to remain in the three-lane catch-up volley
arcana.Naturally benefits from: wide groups; targets behind/along dash line

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Player-following open annulus after dash
arcana.Origin / ownership: Ring remains attached to the live player for 3 s
arcana.Aim model: Radial around player after directional dash
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Instant annulus is 12.44 sq units; unique coverage is movement-dependent and can far exceed that over 3 s.
arcana.Defense: No shield in current base form
arcana.Resource / commitment: 6 s payload cooldown; movement remains available
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets inside the open center are not touched; full burn requires sustained ring contact

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Broad rear-biased circular/curled burst
arcana.Origin / ownership: Brief payload follows the resolved dash direction
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Treated as a disk-equivalent because runtime exposes radius rather than a precise sector.
arcana.Control: Carries caught enemies along the completed dash
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Target must be in the rear-biased catch volume during the dash
arcana.Naturally benefits from: enemies close behind or beside caster

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Origin gather disk → transport draught → endpoint disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: Copied curated dash source owns separate phases
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Largest phase is the 2.7-radius gather disk; endpoint radius is 2.4. Draught union depends on transported target path.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full sequence requires origin capture and successful handoff to the endpoint draught
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Selected curated runtime uses a 4.4-unit dash, 2.7 gather radius, and 2.4 endpoint radius; not the unused generic spec.

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Stationary wake disk after dash
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned near dash origin/wake
arcana.Aim model: Dash direction snapshot; zone itself radial
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Current curated base is a 2.1-radius disk with five 4-damage contacts.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must remain in the one-second wake for all five contacts
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Selected curated runtime is 5 × 4 damage, not the unused four × 5 generic schedule.

arcana.Compound tags: dash trail; shared ledger; sequential eruption
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Sequential dash-route capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: Eruptions sample the collision-clipped route
arcana.Multiplicity / density: Many visible spikes / one shared hit ledger
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Unique route corridor; many segments do not multiply damage or coverage because they share one logical attack.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No special trigger; each target can be hit once by the shared route

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Placed circular poison zone after dash
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned planted zone
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Persistent disk at the planted location.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Enemies must enter or remain in the placed trap to receive poison ticks

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Dash followed by three-projectile fan corridors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Three independent snare carriers
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Projectile fan union; engagement reach includes 8.4 dash plus 8.5 projectile range.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full three-lane value requires multiple aligned targets or a large target

arcana.Compound tags: dash placement; delayed disk; nested sweet spot
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Delayed endpoint disk with nested core disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: Copied curated dash placement produces a telegraphed lightning strike
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Base detonation disk is 2.9 radius; targets inside .85 core receive a separate second 10-damage event.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Core bonus requires proximity to strike center
arcana.Produces states: shocked; delayed zone; center sweet spot
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Live curated runtime is a disk/core strike, not the unused broad-radius plus rectangular-core generic representation.

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Network of node-to-node line capsules
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned nodes connect after arm delay
arcana.Aim model: Each dash/cast places a segment; network topology is player-authored
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Each eligible edge is a capsule up to 7 units long (~9.88 sq units); network union varies with node layout and edge count.
arcana.Resource / commitment: 3 charges; 4 s recharge; 1.5 s arm delay
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Nodes must form at least one link within 7 units; more edges add two extra ticks each
arcana.Produces states: connected hazard; repeated hits; route network
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Selected curated runtime uses 7.0 link range, .62 stream radius, and 6 base hits (+2 per extra edge).

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Short persistent line capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned segment left by dash
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Persistent 4.4-unit capsule; not the full dash length.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must cross or remain on the short line

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Large circular front that can detach and travel
arcana.Origin / ownership: Initially dash/player-associated, then detached carrier
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Approximate detached 4.5-unit travel corridor after release; dash motion can expand practical coverage.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full three-tick value requires target to remain in the moving front

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Dash leaves decoy; enemy attack triggers circular shatter
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned decoy at dash origin
arcana.Aim model: Dash direction; trigger is autonomous enemy response
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Damage area exists only on a valid attack against the decoy.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: An enemy must attack the decoy before it expires
arcana.Naturally benefits from: aggressive melee enemies; grouped around decoy

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Dash followed by four-projectile fan corridors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Four independent shards
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Projectile fan union; engagement reach includes 8.4 dash plus 9 projectile range.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full multi-shard value requires a large/close target or multiple enemies across the fan

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Validated teleport line with no damage geometry
arcana.Origin / ownership: Caster relocates to resolved endpoint
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Utility reach, not attack area; endpoint backs off from invalid terrain.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Endpoint must resolve to navigable space

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two near-full radial sectors during a forward slide
arcana.Origin / ownership: Sweeps are centered on the moving caster/source
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Each sweep covers about 77.9 sq units before considering the 2.4-unit slide; two offset sweeps make cast union still larger.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Second sweep has a .30 s delay and different angular offset

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Dash-contact capsule → independent target-centered blast disks
arcana.Origin / ownership: Markers attach to every distinct crossed enemy
arcana.Aim model: Dash direction snapshot; detonation uses stored direction
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 3 charges; one marker per crossed enemy
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Dash contact corridor is ~12.43 sq units; each marked target later owns a 1.5-radius blast.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Dash must cross a target; marker then detonates reliably after 1 s

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Slow fireball + delayed fast arrow → five-projectile fan on real collision
arcana.Origin / ownership: Parent projectiles remain independent until they physically meet
arcana.Aim model: Fireball activation snapshot; follow-up arrow live-aimed
arcana.Coverage interpretation: 17.22 sq units is the post-fusion five-arrow fan union only; parent corridors remain independently useful and may diverge.
arcana.Resource / commitment: 6 s cooldown; arrow follows .32 s after fireball
arcana.Coded full-value condition: The two moving parent projectiles must actually collide; otherwise no fan exists
arcana.Naturally benefits from: large target area; deliberate aim crossing

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Mobile allied actor with repeated projectile lanes
arcana.Origin / ownership: Agent follows caster and independently chooses nearest hostile
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 1 agent; 25 shots maximum over 10 s at .4 s cadence
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Use 9-unit mobile threat envelope rather than a fixed floor area. Shot life permits a longer physical path, but targets are acquired inside 9.
arcana.Resource / commitment: 15 s cooldown; agent lasts 10 s or until destroyed
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Value depends on agent survival and hostiles remaining inside its attack envelope
arcana.Produces states: agent hits; diverted aggro; repeated autonomous pressure

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Large persistent circular field with destructible center object
arcana.Origin / ownership: Placed 1.45 units ahead and remains world-owned
arcana.Aim model: Activation facing determines placement; field radial
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Large 66.48-square-unit field; reach includes placement distance.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Damage amplification and repeated pulses require enemies to remain inside; overlapping vulnerability does not stack

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Single narrow projectile capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: First valid ordinary enemy becomes player faction
arcana.Multiplicity / density: One projectile; one charmed target at a time
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Narrow projectile corridor; the persistent allied enemy creates a dynamic threat envelope afterward.
arcana.Defense: Charmed enemy fights hostiles and no longer attacks player
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Target must be ordinary/eligible; large enemies and bosses reject conversion

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Rush → enormous fixed vortex disk → landing disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: Vortex is centered at leap route/airborne phase; landing at resolved endpoint
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 5 vortex ticks + landing + optional carried bonus
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Five-radius vortex is 78.54 sq units; landing disk is 32.17. Their centers differ, so whole-cast union is larger.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Extra 50 carried-target payoff requires an eligible nonlarge target in the rush
arcana.Produces states: carried; grouped at landing; projectile-cleared; repositioned

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Very broad outbound capsule with live-owner return path
arcana.Origin / ownership: One carrier has separate outbound and return hit ledgers
arcana.Aim model: Activation snapshot outbound; return homes to live caster
arcana.Coverage interpretation: 28.67-square-unit outbound corridor; return usually reuses it but can bend toward the moving caster.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Second hit requires the return path to cross the target
arcana.Naturally benefits from: grouped; target between turn point and caster

arcana.Compound tags: formation; defense; independent ledgers; open center
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Eight discrete shield disks orbiting in an open-center formation
arcana.Origin / ownership: Formation follows the live caster
arcana.Coverage interpretation: 11.62 is the sum of eight simultaneous shield disks; 30.31 is the annulus they can sweep while orbiting. Center remains open.
arcana.Defense: Every shield erases hostile projectiles without being consumed
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Each shield can hit each target once; full value needs multiple shield contacts or multiple enemies

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Charge-scaled projectile capsule → attached pulse object
arcana.Origin / ownership: Projectile attaches to first target
arcana.Aim model: Live aim during vulnerable charge; snapshot on release
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Full-charge corridor shown; minimum-charge radius .52 gives a much narrower path.
arcana.Control: 7.5 world-unit initial knockback at full spec
arcana.Resource / commitment: 5.5 s cooldown; hold up to 1.5 s while vulnerable
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full charge is required for ten pulses and maximum shock; projectile must then contact a target
arcana.Produces states: maximum shock; attached repeated hits; heavy push

arcana.Compound tags: stored stock; beam; limited sweep; defensive
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Long, wide rectangular beam
arcana.Origin / ownership: Beam origin follows the live player; direction can sweep within ±15° of initial aim
arcana.Coverage interpretation: 31.05-square-unit full-length rectangle before scenery clipping; live limited sweep can enlarge total union.
arcana.Defense: Pierces enemies and erases hostile projectiles
arcana.Resource / commitment: Passively stores 3-10 charges at .75 s each; spends all
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full ten-tick value requires maximum stock and targets staying in the sweeping beam

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Player-following capture disk + remote destination storm disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: Capture field follows player until recast/2 s delay; rod/storm are world-owned
arcana.Aim model: Directional rod placement; second activation or timeout
arcana.Multiplicity / density: Capture field + arrival event + 5 storm ticks
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Capture disk is 45.36 sq units; destination storm is 29.22. Their remote centers make whole-cast union much larger.
arcana.Control: Teleports eligible ordinary enemies; inward arrival/storm forces
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must be inside the moving capture field at trigger time and have a valid landing; large enemies are immune
arcana.Naturally benefits from: dense ordinary enemies; prepared destination zone

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Fixed rounded frontal sector
arcana.Origin / ownership: Snapshots cast frame; does not follow later player movement
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Sector estimate uses half-angle .80 and 3.4 reach; max reach includes .5 origin offset.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Targets must stay in the snapshot cone through three hit times

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Growing fixed disk with larger finisher disk
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned at original cast frame
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Finisher is a 60.82-square-unit disk; tick radius grows only to about 3.27.
arcana.Control: Low inward force then 2.2 outward push
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full sequence requires targets to remain near the original cast point until finisher
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Card language can read like a caster-following crown, but gameplay stays at the original cast frame.

arcana.Compound tags: ordered ground line; carry; endpoint finisher
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Five overlapping circular explosions walking down a line
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned ordered beat centers
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Current five-disk union is ~28.25 sq units; centers run from 2.25 to 9.25 forward.
arcana.Control: Early beats move targets toward the next center
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full payoff requires early beats to keep the target aligned into the endpoint finisher

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Three separated trigger disks
arcana.Origin / ownership: Each trap is independently world-owned and consumed
arcana.Aim model: Authored placement around caster; no live targeting
arcana.Multiplicity / density: 3 traps; first valid target per trap
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Three current trigger disks have ~7.98 sq units of unique union and are intentionally separated rather than one large circle.
arcana.Control: Pulls triggering target to trap center
arcana.Resource / commitment: One cast places three traps for 3.2 s
arcana.Coded full-value condition: A target must enter an unconsumed .92-radius trap; then all five ticks are target-owned
arcana.Produces states: captured; grouped at trap; repeated-hit window

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Huge fixed disk centered 2.7 units ahead
arcana.Origin / ownership: World-owned dragon-mouth center at cast frame
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Finisher disk is 66.48 sq units; pull disk is radius 4.2 and projectile-clearing volume radius 4.3.
arcana.Control: Repeated pull then 2.45 outward blast; slow
arcana.Defense: Erases hostile projectiles in visible mouth volume
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full six-hit value requires target retention near the mouth center
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Gameplay collision is a very large disk, broader than the directional mouth silhouette may imply.

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Six large offset disks → larger finisher disk while caster dashes
arcana.Origin / ownership: Gameplay hit checks remain relative to the initial cast frame
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Current gameplay union of seven hit circles is ~31.96 sq units; player separately dashes 6.6 units.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full seven-hit value requires targets to remain within the cast-frame circle sequence
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Hit circles only advance about 3.4 units from the original cast frame while the player dashes 6.6; collision is not truly synchronized to the full live route.

arcana.Compound tags: curtain; carry; wall slam; dead zone
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Broad moving rectangular curtain with point-blank gap
arcana.Origin / ownership: Independent advancing field
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Travel corridor is about 33.70 sq units after the deliberate 1.7-unit spawn gap.
arcana.Control: Carries targets; wall impact adds stun
arcana.Coded full-value condition: 30 bonus damage and 1.35 s stun require a carried target to hit a wall

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Seeking falcon → target-centered six-pass orbit
arcana.Origin / ownership: Falcon autonomously marks first valid target
arcana.Aim model: Autonomous seek and authored target orbit
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Use target-centered threat path rather than floor area: six .2 s passes around a 2.9-unit orbit.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Requires a valid target; full value needs the marked target to survive all six passes

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two mobile agents repeatedly create charge corridors
arcana.Origin / ownership: Agents follow, seek, and overshoot targets
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Use 11-unit seek envelope and repeated dynamic charge lanes rather than one fixed area.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Value depends on agent survival and reachable targets
arcana.Produces states: agent hits; pushed; possible wall slam; diverted aggro

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Huge straight projectile capsule
arcana.Origin / ownership: One fast boulder
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Wide 29.47-square-unit swept corridor.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: No follow-up condition; one contact delivers full current payload

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Fast single projectile; collision radius not exposed in public tuning
arcana.Origin / ownership: One vine-linked bola
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Range is code-grounded; carrier radius is not exposed in the selected tuning, so area remains unranked pending a collision audit.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Once projectile contact occurs, root and five poison ticks are reliable
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: Needs exact live collision-radius extraction before area ranking.

arcana.Compound tags: ground projectile; two lanes; repeated contact
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Two separated, slightly splayed ground-carrier capsules
arcana.Origin / ownership: Two parallel stone saws
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Current two-lane union is ~41.26 sq units; lanes are 1.75 apart and slightly splayed.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Full value requires target retention in one moving saw for repeated contacts

arcana.Gameplay geometry: Mobile agent repeatedly creates target-centered circular stomps
arcana.Origin / ownership: Agent follows caster, seeks, leaps, and lands
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Each stomp is a 34.21-square-unit disk inside a mobile 9.5-unit seek envelope.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Value depends on agent survival and targets inside seek range
arcana.Produces states: agent hits; pushed; repeated radial pressure

arcana.Compound tags: radial lanes; huge coverage; repeated contact
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Nine radial ground capsules tunneling outward
arcana.Origin / ownership: Standalone source anchored at cast point
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Approximate 189-square-unit union after the live adapter's baked 2× source scale; nine even radial corridors from ~1.1 to 9.2.
arcana.Coded full-value condition: Five-hit ceiling requires a target to intersect multiple sequential rock contacts
arcana.Audit flags / implementation notes: One of four standalone-source cards with an additional baked 2× world scale at Arcana Size 1.

arcana.Compound tags: mass capture; target seeking; enormous radius
arcana.Gameplay geometry: Expanding capture disk → target-seeking crags → target-owned fists
arcana.Origin / ownership: Standalone source anchored at caster
arcana.Aim model: Radial acquisition; autonomous target pursuit after release
arcana.Multiplicity / density: One crag/fist per eligible target in disk
arcana.Coverage interpretation: Effective max capture disk is ~265.90 sq units after baked 2× source scale.
arcana.Control: Captures/holds every eligible target; stun bridge in adapter
arcana.Resource / commitment: Auto-charges to max over 1.35 s in current adapter; 7.5 s source cooldown
